question: Yashika buys 6 apples and 6 mangoes for ₹216. When the cost of an apple is decreased by 30% and that of a mango remains the same, then the cost of 5 apples and 8 mangoes is ₹162. What is the original cost of 7 apples and 2 mangoes?
solution:
Calculations:

6 apples + 6 mangoes = ₹216

⇒ a = cost of 1 apple, m = cost of 1 mango

6a + 6m = 216 ⇒ a + m = 36 ----- (i)

When apple price ↓ 30%, new apple price = 0.7a

5(0.7a) + 8m = 162
